notes: Added stories covering schema contract, core enforcement logic, API layer, integration, and testing gaps for server-side scope enforcement.

GPTR-F-001-S52.title: Request Schema and Validation Contract
GPTR-F-001-S52.description: Define strict Pydantic schema for GPTReader requests including collection, filters, projections, limits, and sort. Reject malformed or extra fields before enforcement layer.

GPTR-F-001-S53.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S53.description: Implement core validation engine that checks request against allowlist (collections, fields, operators) and rejects any non-compliant query prior to execution.

GPTR-F-001-S54.title: API Enforcement Middleware Integration
GPTR-F-001-S54.description: Integrate enforcement engine into Azure Function entrypoint ensuring all incoming GPTReader requests pass through validation before any database interaction.

GPTR-F-001-S55.title: Integration with Mongo Query Execution Path
GPTR-F-001-S55.description: Ensure validated requests are safely transformed into Mongo queries with enforced projections and limits, preventing bypass of allowlist via downstream execution paths.

GPTR-F-001-S56.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Enforcement
GPTR-F-001-S56.description: Create comprehensive tests covering valid queries, allowlist violations, schema failures, and edge cases including nested filters and projection abuse.
